name: Rehum
bio: Rehum, a Persian official in Samaria, wrote to King Artaxerxes along with Shimshai the scribe and others, accusing the Jews rebuilding Jerusalem of restoring a historically rebellious city that would stop paying tribute if finished. Artaxerxes agreed and ordered the work stopped; Rehum and Shimshai hurried to Jerusalem and forced the builders to cease by force, halting the temple's reconstruction until the reign of Darius (Ezra 4:8-24).
